_comment: Facts the dependency scanner cannot see. build_sbom.py merges them into every FoaMES SBOM. Keep each entry true to the code it names; review this file when the code it points at changes.

components.name: erpnext
components.description: Optional. The ERPNext adapter activates only when ERPNext is installed on the same site; FoaMES never imports it otherwise.

cryptographic_assets.name: HMAC-SHA256
cryptographic_assets.description: Signs and verifies machine events posted to the webhook: hex HMAC-SHA256 over '<timestamp>.<body>' with the shared secret from Machine Data Settings, checked with a constant-time compare and a replay window. Also the symmetric signature of every OPC UA message under the three security policies the OPC UA gateway offers, with a 256-bit key derived for each secure channel.

properties.name: foames:crypto:implementation
properties.value: Python standard library hmac and hashlib (webhook)

properties.name: foames:crypto:implementation
properties.value: asyncua security_policies on the cryptography package (OpenSSL of the host); FoaMES selects the policy and supplies the certificate, key and mode (OPC UA)

cryptographic_assets.name: SHA-256
cryptographic_assets.description: Derives identifiers, not secrets: External Reference keys and the document markers that make ERPNext, S/4HANA, Insights Hub and other MES postings idempotent. Also the hash inside HMAC-SHA256.

cryptographic_assets.name: RSA-OAEP (SHA-1)
cryptographic_assets.description: Asymmetric encryption of the OPC UA OpenSecureChannel handshake (nonces and the material the session keys are derived from) under the server's certificate, and of the user password token when the server's token policy asks for it. OAEP with SHA-1 and MGF1-SHA1, as the Basic256Sha256 and Aes128_Sha256_RsaOaep profiles of OPC UA Part 7 fix it; the hash is a padding parameter here, not a collision-resistant primitive. RSA keys of 2048 to 4096 bits.

properties.name: foames:crypto:implementation
properties.value: asyncua security_policies on the cryptography package (OpenSSL of the host); FoaMES selects the policy and supplies the certificate, key and mode

cryptographic_assets.name: RSA-OAEP (SHA-256)
cryptographic_assets.description: The same handshake encryption under the Aes256_Sha256_RsaPss profile: OAEP with SHA-256 and MGF1-SHA256. RSA keys of 2048 to 4096 bits.

properties.name: foames:crypto:implementation
properties.value: asyncua security_policies on the cryptography package (OpenSSL of the host); FoaMES selects the policy and supplies the certificate, key and mode

cryptographic_assets.name: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 with SHA-256
cryptographic_assets.description: Asymmetric signature of the OPC UA OpenSecureChannel messages with the gateway's private key, and verification of the server's, under Basic256Sha256 and Aes128_Sha256_RsaOaep. Also the signature algorithm the OPC UA profiles require on the application instance certificates themselves (sha256WithRSAEncryption).

properties.name: foames:crypto:implementation
properties.value: asyncua security_policies on the cryptography package (OpenSSL of the host); FoaMES selects the policy and supplies the certificate, key and mode

cryptographic_assets.name: RSA-PSS with SHA-256
cryptographic_assets.description: Asymmetric signature of the OPC UA OpenSecureChannel messages under Aes256_Sha256_RsaPss: PSS with SHA-256, MGF1-SHA256 and a 32-byte salt. RSA keys of 2048 to 4096 bits. The certificates themselves stay signed with RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 and SHA-256 under this policy too, so that asset is part of its cipher suite as well.

properties.name: foames:crypto:implementation
properties.value: asyncua security_policies on the cryptography package (OpenSSL of the host); FoaMES selects the policy and supplies the certificate, key and mode

cryptographic_assets.name: AES-256-CBC
cryptographic_assets.description: Symmetric encryption of OPC UA messages after the handshake, under Basic256Sha256 and Aes256_Sha256_RsaPss, with a key and IV derived for each secure channel. Used only in mode SignAndEncrypt; mode Sign signs without encrypting.

properties.name: foames:crypto:implementation
properties.value: asyncua security_policies on the cryptography package (OpenSSL of the host); FoaMES selects the policy and supplies the certificate, key and mode

cryptographic_assets.name: AES-128-CBC
cryptographic_assets.description: Symmetric encryption of OPC UA messages under Aes128_Sha256_RsaOaep, with a key and IV derived for each secure channel. Used only in mode SignAndEncrypt.

properties.name: foames:crypto:implementation
properties.value: asyncua security_policies on the cryptography package (OpenSSL of the host); FoaMES selects the policy and supplies the certificate, key and mode

cryptographic_assets.name: P_SHA256 key derivation
cryptographic_assets.description: Derives the signing key, encryption key and IV of each OPC UA secure channel from the client and server nonces exchanged in the handshake: the HMAC-SHA256 pseudo-random function of WS-SecureConversation that all three offered policies use.

properties.name: foames:crypto:implementation
properties.value: asyncua security_policies on the cryptography package (OpenSSL of the host); FoaMES selects the policy and supplies the certificate, key and mode

cryptographic_assets.name: TLS
cryptographic_assets.description: Transport security for S/4HANA OData and IDoc calls for Insights Hub REST calls and for the other MES adapters' REST calls (Python ssl default context, optional custom CA file) and for MQTT and Sparkplug B when MQTT TLS is switched on in Machine Data Settings. The version and cipher suites are whatever the host's OpenSSL negotiates; FoaMES does not pin them.

cryptographic_assets.name: OPC UA secure channel
cryptographic_assets.description: Message security between the OPC UA gateway and the OPC UA server (OPC UA Part 4 and Part 6 secure conversation, opc.tcp). Off by default: Machine Data Settings chooses mode None, Sign or SignAndEncrypt and one of three security policies. With mode None nothing is signed or encrypted, and the gateway logs a warning at every start. Sign authenticates every message; SignAndEncrypt also encrypts them. The policy decides the algorithms, listed as cipher suites below with their OPC UA policy URIs. The deprecated Basic128Rsa15 and Basic256 policies are not offered. The server's certificate is taken from its endpoint unless a Server Certificate is attached, which pins it; with a Trusted Certificates bundle attached, asyncua's certificate_validator hook refuses a server certificate that is not in the bundle or chained to it, is outside its validity period, or does not carry the server's application URI.

properties.name: foames:crypto:implementation
properties.value: asyncua security_policies on the cryptography package (OpenSSL of the host); FoaMES selects the policy and supplies the certificate, key and mode

cryptographic_assets.name: OPC UA gateway application instance certificate
cryptographic_assets.description: The X.509 certificate the OPC UA gateway presents to the server in modes Sign and SignAndEncrypt, attached to Machine Data Settings as DER or PEM and read from disk when the gateway starts. Its subjectAltName URI must equal the Client Application URI. Subject, issuer and validity are set by the plant that issues it, so they are not recorded here; docs/machine-data.md shows a self-signed RSA-2048 certificate signed with sha256WithRSAEncryption. The site CBOM (foames.foames_mes.site_cbom) fills in the deployed certificate's subject, issuer, validity, key and fingerprint.

cryptographic_assets.name: OPC UA server certificate (pinned)
cryptographic_assets.description: Optional. The OPC UA server's own X.509 certificate, attached to Machine Data Settings. When it is attached the gateway encrypts the handshake to this certificate instead of the one the server offers, so a substituted server at the same address cannot complete the channel. Without it the certificate the server presents in its endpoint description is used, and checked against the Trusted Certificates bundle when one is attached. The site CBOM (foames.foames_mes.site_cbom) fills in the deployed certificate's subject, issuer, validity, key and fingerprint.

cryptographic_assets.name: OPC UA trusted certificates bundle
cryptographic_assets.description: Optional. A PEM bundle, or one DER file, of X.509 certificates attached to Machine Data Settings: the plant CA, or the OPC UA server certificates themselves. When attached, the gateway accepts a server certificate only when it is one of these or chains to one through them, every link is within its validity period, and the certificate carries the server's application URI. Saving the settings is refused when the file holds no certificate. The site CBOM lists each certificate of the bundle.

cryptographic_assets.name: Machine event webhook secret
cryptographic_assets.description: The shared HMAC key for the machine event webhook. Stored in a Password field of Machine Data Settings and read with get_password; never logged.

cryptographic_assets.name: OPC UA gateway private key
cryptographic_assets.description: The RSA private key of the gateway certificate, 2048 to 4096 bits, attached to Machine Data Settings as a PEM or DER file. Saving the settings is refused unless the file is a private Frappe File, so it is never served without a session. Read from disk by the gateway at start; never logged.

cryptographic_assets.name: OPC UA private key passphrase
cryptographic_assets.description: The passphrase of the gateway private key when the key file is encrypted. Stored in a Password field of Machine Data Settings and read with get_password; never logged.

cryptographic_assets.name: ERP and broker credentials
cryptographic_assets.description: S/4HANA Basic credentials or OAuth 2.0 client ID and secret, the Insights Hub client ID and secret, each MES Connection's password, bearer token, API key or client secret, the MQTT broker password and the OPC UA user password. Stored in Password fields of S4HANA Settings, Insights Hub Settings, MES Connection and Machine Data Settings; never in code, hooks or site config.

cryptographic_assets.name: S/4HANA OAuth bearer token
cryptographic_assets.description: The access token returned by the OAuth 2.0 token endpoint. Held in memory by the OData client for its lifetime and sent as a bearer credential; never stored or logged.

cryptographic_assets.name: Insights Hub bearer token
cryptographic_assets.description: The access token the Technical Token Manager or the tenant's OAuth 2.0 token endpoint returns. Held in memory by the REST client for its lifetime and sent as a bearer credential; never stored or logged.

cryptographic_assets.name: MES OAuth bearer token
cryptographic_assets.description: The access token an MES Connection with OAuth 2.0 client credentials receives from the system's token endpoint (SAP XSUAA, Proficy UAA, AVEVA Connect). Held in memory by the REST client for its lifetime and sent as a bearer credential; never stored or logged.

provided_services.name: FoaMES machine event webhook
provided_services.description: Exposed by FoaMES. PLC gateways and IoT bridges POST machine events here. A Guest request must carry X-FoaMES-Timestamp and an X-FoaMES-Signature HMAC-SHA256 within the replay window; a logged-in session or API token of a user with the FoaMES Operator, FoaMES Engineer or System Manager role is accepted without the signature.

provided_services.name: FoaMES S/4HANA IDoc receiver
provided_services.description: Exposed by FoaMES when the S/4HANA adapter is enabled. SAP sends IDoc XML here over HTTP; the caller must be a Frappe user allowed to create S4HANA Inbound IDoc records.

external_services.name: MQTT broker (plain MQTT and Sparkplug B)
external_services.description: FoaMES subscribes to the broker from the MQTT and Sparkplug B gateways. Read-only: FoaMES never publishes commands. A user name and password are sent only when configured in Machine Data Settings, and TLS is off unless switched on there.

external_services.name: OPC UA server
external_services.description: FoaMES polls mapped nodes from the OPC UA gateway. Read-only. It connects anonymously unless a user name and password are configured. Message security follows Machine Data Settings: mode None (the default) leaves the session unsigned and unencrypted, so it belongs on a protected OT network segment; Sign or SignAndEncrypt with Basic256Sha256, Aes128_Sha256_RsaOaep or Aes256_Sha256_RsaPss authenticates the gateway with its X.509 certificate and signs, or signs and encrypts, every message. See the OPC UA secure channel protocol asset in the CBOM.

external_services.name: SAP S/4HANA released OData APIs
external_services.description: Optional. The S/4HANA adapter reads master and order data over OData and sends postings through the outbox, with Basic or OAuth 2.0 bearer authentication. No RFC. Inbound IDocs arrive through the FoaMES IDoc receiver.

external_services.name: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint for S/4HANA
external_services.description: Optional. Used only when S4HANA Settings selects OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials: FoaMES posts the client ID and secret to the configured token URL, which may be on a different host from S/4HANA (for example SAP BTP), and receives a bearer token.

external_services.name: Siemens Insights Hub platform APIs (Opcenter Intelligence)
external_services.description: Optional. The Insights Hub adapter reads assets over Asset Management, resolves the Opcenter Intelligence resources a site maps, and writes machine production as IoT time series records and state changes as events through the outbox, all behind the region gateway with a bearer token. Tokens come from the Technical Token Manager on the same gateway, or from the tenant's OAuth 2.0 token endpoint when service credentials are used.

external_services.name: Other MES and MOM systems' REST APIs
external_services.description: Optional, one connection per system. The MES profiles (Rockwell Plex and FactoryTalk ProductionCentre, SAP Digital Manufacturing, DELMIA Apriso, AVEVA MES, Critical Manufacturing, Tulip, Aegis FactoryLogix, Körber PAS-X, Proficy) resolve mapped references and send outbox writes over HTTPS with Basic, bearer token, API key header or OAuth 2.0 client credentials authentication, as each MES Connection is configured. Endpoints are per installation; the examples are the vendors' public gateways.
